lines.arrive: A clear night. More stars than anyone could count.
lines.listen: Only static. The hiss of the stars.
lines.stars: Billions of stars, and around most of them, planets.
lines.old: Some are far older than the Sun. Someone should have come by now.
lines.send_1: Your message leaves at the speed of light.
lines.send_2: Years pass. Nothing comes back. Maybe no one is there. Or maybe they're listening too, and staying quiet.
lines.listen_end: Nights become years. Only static. Either they're rare, or they're quiet, or we're early.
lines.logbook: The log goes back years. Every night, the same entry. Nothing.
lines.tea: Your tea has gone cold. It always does, out here.
lines.moon: Only one other world has ever had visitors. They left footprints, and went home.
